FREE AUDIO SOURCES AND MODIFICATIONS

Music by Beau Buckley (OpenGameArt user Opus Magno):
Plains 01, Plains 02, Castle 03, Cave 01, Battle 01, Opening 03.
https://opengameart.org/content/plains-01
https://opengameart.org/content/plains-02
https://opengameart.org/content/castle-03
https://opengameart.org/content/cave-01
https://opengameart.org/content/battle-01
https://opengameart.org/content/opening-03
License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International.
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
All modified music audio and arrangement MIDIs in this package remain under
CC BY-SA 4.0. Credit Beau Buckley; indicate modifications and preserve this
license for redistributed music adaptations. This notice applies to the music
assets, not a claim that unrelated game code has the same license.
Day modifications: level adjustment and 0.5-second loop crossfade.
Night modifications: slower same source MIDI, unchanged first-voice pitches,
piano and harp programs, reduced velocities, accompaniment thinning and
percussion removal. Menu: two source voices arranged for piano and harp.
Original and arrangement MIDI files are supplied alongside this notice.

RPG Sound Pack by HaelDB: CC0 1.0 Universal.
https://opengameart.org/content/rpg-sound-pack
Interface Sounds and RPG Audio by Kenney: CC0 1.0 Universal.
https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds
https://kenney.nl/assets/rpg-audio
Forest Ambience by TinyWorlds: CC0 1.0 Universal.
https://opengameart.org/content/forest-ambience
Crickets Ambient Noise by Wolfgang_; optional credit Ted Kerr: CC0 1.0.
https://opengameart.org/content/crickets-ambient-noise-loopable
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
SFX edits: level adjustment; several magic cues have pitch/length/fade edits.
Ambience edits: level adjustment and loop crossfade. Village ambience currently
uses outdoor nature textures, not a claim of recorded town crowds.

Night/menu rendered using GeneralUser GS by S. Christian Collins.
https://github.com/mrbumpy409/GeneralUser-GS
The author's license permits private/commercial music recordings; full text
is preserved in GeneralUser_GS_LICENSE.txt, including its sample-source caveat.
SoundFont is a local build dependency, not distributed with the game.
Renderer: FluidSynth (LGPL), a local build tool, not distributed with the game.

See manifest.json for exact source members, modifications and output hashes.
Saved source pages preserve the license and attribution claims observed when
acquiring the assets. File availability is not treated as license permission.

Combat SFX revision 2026-10-12: hit/critical hit use Kenney punch impacts; block uses plate impact; death uses soft heavy impact (neutral body fall, no voice). Kenney Impact Sounds: CC0. https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
Shot: pistol.wav by Michel Baradari (apollo-music.de), submitted by qubodup, CC BY 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/ ; https://opengameart.org/content/chaingun-pistol-rifle-shotgun-shots . Modified volume and OGG encoding. Preserve author and license on distribution.
